damage_description:
Make-safe type: Ceiling / water ingress
Damage: Burst water pipe and wet insulation in roof
work_done: Investigated in major water ingress, found burst water pipe, informed MLB on urgent call for plumber, removed all wet insulation from roof space. Disposed of 10 bags of wet insulation

damage_description:
Make-safe type: Temporary fencing
Damage: Moisture inside walls of walkway and kitchen.
work_done: Re attended property and checked water ingresses walls using moisture meter to check if the walls where dry or drier since the installation of 3 fans and dehumidifier a week prior. Walls slightly dried but definitely still have moisture inside and need longer drying time.

damage_description:
Make-safe type: Other: Scraping back walls (RESTORATION)
Damage: High levels of moisture in walls not escaping even with the use of high rated fans and dehumidifier.
work_done: Scraped back the render off the brick hallway wall, above kitchen sink, and besides kitchen cupboard. Too allow the moisture In the wall to dry out.

damage_description:
Make-safe type: Other: Check moisture reading
Damage: Checked moisture reading of wall and uninstalled 3 fans and dehumidifier, returning equipment.
work_done: Checked moisture reading of wall and uninstalled 3 fans and dehumidifier, returning equipment.
